# Messer Paste

A single-user pastebin: text, images and files, with expiry and burn-after-reading.
Everything below needs a bearer token from a 0600 file, or a an authenticating proxy service token.

## Write a paste from stdin

  printf 'error log…' | curl -sS -X POST https://paste.example.com/api/v1/pastes \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $PASTE_TOKEN" \
    -F title="build log" -F expires_in=86400 -F text=-

## Write a paste from a file (multipart)

  curl -sS -X POST https://paste.example.com/api/v1/pastes \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $PASTE_TOKEN" \
    -F title="screenshot" -F expires_in=0 \
    -F file=@shot.png

## Read the newest paste

  curl -sS "https://paste.example.com/api/v1/pastes?limit=1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PASTE_TOKEN"
  curl -sS https://paste.example.com/api/v1/pastes/<slug> -H "Authorization: Bearer $PASTE_TOKEN"

## Search titles, filenames and text

  curl -sS "https://paste.example.com/api/v1/pastes?q=arm64" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PASTE_TOKEN"

Each item carries `match.field` and a `match.snippet`; U+0001 and U+0002 wrap the hit.

## Delete

  curl -sS -X DELETE https://paste.example.com/api/v1/pastes/<slug> -H "Authorization: Bearer $PASTE_TOKEN"

## Contract

  GET /api/v1/openapi.json

Timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC. Errors are {"error":{"code","message"}} with a stable code.
Listing is paginated: ?limit=&cursor=, response has next_cursor and has_more.
POST /pastes accepts an Idempotency-Key header; a retry returns the original paste.

## CLI (same API, no curl)

  paste put file.log -t "build log" --expires 7d
  paste get latest
  paste ls -q arm64

On the host that runs the container, `docker exec -i messer-paste messer-paste put -` needs no token.
